verdict.rationale: Shortwave ships a built-in AI Assistant that can read threads, write drafts, search email history and check your calendar. It extends to complex cross-app workflows through built-in integrations and MCP, accepts remembered preferences, and can act automatically via triggers. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI Assistant's task-delegation quality (community evidence does not discuss the assistant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more
connects our AI Assistant to all your business applications, letting you accomplish complex workflows without ever leaving your inbox.

Read, summarize, and analyze PDF, text, code, and other file types with the AI Assistant
